summary.headline: Muhamed’s Nativity and Hellenic Petitions
summary.text: Apomasar’s astrological account of the prophet Muhamed’s nativity, identifying Libra, Scorpio, Spica, and planetary configurations as signs of religious authority and dynastic duration, followed by predictions of religious change and Saracen wars. A further section describes Hellenic petitions to God using the Ascending Node, Zeus, the Moon, and the horoscopos lord.
